name: Ashni Singh
detail: Senior Minister in the Office of the President with Responsibility for Finance; introduced Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2024 which added Section 6(y) exempting individuals from Property Tax

name: Irfaan Ali
detail: President of Guyana; policy initiative to axe property tax on individuals to encourage private savings and lower compliance burdens

name: Clive Thomas
detail: Economist and WPA leader; proposed the Buxton Proposal (direct universal cash transfers to households from oil revenues), but has not proposed or endorsed a net wealth tax

name: Hemdutt Kumar
detail: Author of letter to Stabroek News 'Removal of property tax is a victory for the wealthy and a betrayal of the poor' (2025-12-20); frequent public letter writer and property owner without institutional or public role

name: Nigel Hinds
detail: Chartered Accountant and 2020 prime ministerial candidate for Change Guyana; campaigned to abolish the property tax, describing it as oppressive

name: Ramon Gaskin
detail: Outspoken economist and activist; died December 2023. Criticised tax holidays and exemptions granted to oil multinationals under the Stabroek PSA, without proposing an annual personal wealth tax
